item.title: Aitracker 1.0.1
item.description:
• Fixed: adding another Claude account no longer disconnects the previous one. Each new login now uses its own separate browser window. Accounts added in 1.0.0 may need to be reconnected once.
  • Fixed: an account whose session ended now shows Reconnect instead of outdated numbers.
  • Fixed: a leftover profile linked to Claude Code could spend tokens on every refresh.

item.title: Aitracker 1.0.0
item.description:
• First release of Aitracker: the limits and credits of all your AI accounts in the menu bar.
  • Sign in with your own browser and track several accounts, even from the same company.
  • Claude, ChatGPT (Codex), Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Meshy and Tripo.
  • 14 languages, following your system by default.
